node.statement: Ambient projection control: the star-preserving delta-homomorphism property gives R^dagger=R and ||R dot R-R||<=delta in S_P. Since def-compressed-corner gives ||R dot R-RR||<=O(e)||R||^2, the preceding norm and closeness bounds imply ||R^2-R||<=C_2 e and ||R||<=M_2, with universal C_2,M_2; enlarging constants proves node 1.1.
